title: Character roster: rig, retarget, and in-app selection
summary: Build the v1 avatar as a curated roster of pre-made, rigged, semi-photorealistic 1:12 characters (ADR-0006, AUTH #020). Each shares the GJ humanoid skeleton and retargets the shared animation/traversal set; the player selects one; the two cosmetic IAP SKUs reskin it. No face/body capture, no biometric processing. Roster = 8 at launch on an inclusive casting matrix (≥6 floor); one enforced rig standard (Unity Humanoid, IK/contact markers, AUTH #021 carried-tool sockets) checked by an automated rig-conformance gate; grounded semi-photoreal for v1 with a V2 hero-photoreal roadmap on the same rig; cosmetics gated by a verb+tool clip test; sourcing = dual-track with open-base authoring primary at $0 (AUTH #024).

acceptance_tests.test: A roster of eight (≥6 floor) rigged, semi-photorealistic 1:12 characters loads in Unity 6, each retargeting the shared GJ humanoid skeleton and animation/traversal set with no manual per-character fixes; an automated rig-conformance gate validates bone count, T-pose, eye height, scale, and AUTH #021 carried-tool socket presence.

In-app character selection: the chosen character carries into play and the diorama; the cosmetic IAP SKUs (outfit pack, realism+ materials) preview and apply on the selected character; each cosmetic passes the rig-conformance gate and a clip test across the full verb + tool set (no clipping or rig break during wall-run, dive-roll, climbs, grapple, pole-vault).

No face or body capture path exists and no biometric data is collected (verifies AUTH #020 / SECURITY_CHECKLIST §5 is v1-N/A); a sourcing review confirms every character has full commercial rights and no resemblance to an identifiable real person (no scanned-people libraries, no MetaHuman/Unreal-only assets).
acceptance_tests.evidence: code review + sourcing/IP review + Coordinator sign-off

acceptance_tests.test: A tester picks a character and it moves identically well across five environments.

The eight launch characters satisfy the inclusive casting matrix (a spread across body type, apparent gender presentation, skin tone, apparent age) and are tellable apart at 15 cm by distinct silhouette + colorblind-distinct hero color.
